text:
```yaml
name: Rule Type Param Changes Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-references:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update CODEOWNERS
        run: |
          sed -i 's/kibana\/cloud-security-posture/kibana\/contextual-security/g' CODEOWNERS

      - name: Update GitHub workflows
        run: |
          find .github/workflows -type f -exec sed -i 's/kibana\/cloud-security-posture/kibana\/contextual-security/g' {} +

      - name: Update team references in .github folders
        run: |
          find .github -type f -exec sed -i 's/kibana\/cloud-security-posture/kibana\/contextual-security/g' {} +

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update references to renamed GitHub group"
          git push origin HEAD

      - name: Create comment on PR
        id: create_comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-comment@v2
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            The references to the renamed GitHub group `kibana/cloud-security-posture` have been updated to `kibana/contextual-security`.

            Please review the changes and merge this PR when ready.
```
